editorial_requirements: Write five original 200-400 word passages, each with four questions of a single format.
Use three MC passages and two TFC passages; use 15 normal and 5 hard questions overall.

Research these five distinct topics: cork oak bark harvesting, paper marbling, tidal mills, Scottish vitrified forts, and fog collection meshes. Choose a different topic only if credible sources or novelty checks require it.
Use passage evidence alone for answers and map material factual claims to credible sources in the manifest.
